rationale: Width four is the smallest breadth sensitivity that exact-evaluates source candidates ranked three and four. Width eight adds no first-round candidate because the frozen selector exposes at most four unique attempts per parent.
stop_rule: If width four does not improve the audited 58-CNOT, 8-parameter endpoint, width eight is not run and S8 freezes a negative structural-floor conclusion.
claim_boundary: Known LiH breadth calibration only; not confirmatory evidence.
